T0307.title: First-Hand Source Panel
T0307.definition: A first-hand direct source is an upstream black-market operator who directly controls the origin of illicit funds and core collection/channel resources (colloquially called a 'first-hand operator' or 'operator'), maintaining a stable pool of dirty money and distribution channels—sitting at the head of the money-laundering and fund-flow chain.
T0307.description: Sitting at the top of the money-laundering chain, a first-hand direct source holds the most upstream illegal funds, such as proceeds from gambling or fraud. They directly control a large number of bank accounts, payment accounts, or crypto addresses used for collection, offering a 'first-hand' laundering channel. They are also commonly called a 'first-hand operator' or 'operator'—an operator who directly controls core funding and channel resources at the top of the fraud and laundering chain. Downstream running crews, laundering intermediaries, or layered agents must connect with them to obtain a stable supply of 'material' for washing. True operators rarely interact with clients directly and keep a highly concealed identity, working only with specific channels; most intermediaries claiming to be 'first-hand' are in fact middlemen.
T0307.usageExample: First-hand direct source looking for partners, gambling material, regular clean mix and blended material all available, channels stable; local first-hand operator, big-data score 65+, flexible communication.
